verdict.rationale: Remote documents registrable outbound webhooks that push events to your endpoint so you don't have to poll. The docs cover Sandbox test deliveries, production callback registration, X-Remote-Signature verification, and CLI management of subscriptions with delivery history and replays. However, the only event shown from the available-webhooks catalog is company.eor_hiring.verification_completed, so the payroll lifecycle events this story names are not evidenced. missing for 10: evidence of payroll-processed, employee-onboarded, and payment-failed event types; full event catalog; independent or hands-on corroboration.
